execution.application: src/neuroquest (first slice: reviewer, portfolio, human decision)

context.estimate: ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 4); heuristic, not a tokenizer

llm_policy.enforcement: enforced by src/neuroquest: per-run USD cap checked before each call
llm_policy.provider: groq, google, mistral via OpenAI-compatible endpoints (ADR-022); bare IDs use openai
llm_policy.sdk: openai-python with per-provider base_url, called directly in LangGraph nodes
llm_policy.structured_output: JSON mode with Pydantic schema in the prompt, validated with one repair (OpenAI: Structured Outputs)
llm_policy.prompt_caching: automatic provider prefix caching; measure cached_tokens, never assume
llm_policy.tracing: langsmith (LANGSMITH_TRACING); synthetic and public data only
llm_policy.prices: NEUROQUEST_MODEL_PRICES (USD per 1M tokens per model ID); runs fail safely without them
